idle: It breathes slowly and gently, sways a tiny bit side to side, turns its head slightly to look to the left, then to the right, then back to the front, and settles into exactly the starting pose.
listen: It leans its big head slightly forward and tilts it to one side attentively as if listening carefully to someone, clasping its stubby paws together in front of its belly, giving small understanding nods, then straightens up back into exactly the starting pose.
think: It raises one stubby paw to the bottom edge of its head as if touching its chin, tilts its head slowly to one side and then the other while pondering, taps its chin twice, then lowers the paw back into exactly the starting pose.
talk: It talks animatedly: it gestures expressively with both stubby arms as if explaining something friendly, small bounces and head bobs, opening its arms wide once, then returns to exactly the starting pose.
joy: It gets super happy: it throws both stubby arms up in the air and does two joyful little hops in place, wiggles happily, then lands and settles into exactly the starting pose.
love: It hugs itself with both stubby arms, blissfully sways side to side as if feeling loved and cozy, squishes a little, then releases the hug back into exactly the starting pose.
sad: It becomes sad: its head and shoulders slowly droop down, arms hang limp, it lets out a small sigh with its body sinking a bit, stays gloomy, then slowly perks back up into exactly the starting pose.
surprised: It is suddenly startled: it does a quick small jump back with both stubby arms up in surprise, freezes for a moment, then relaxes and returns to exactly the starting pose.
sleep: It gets sleepy: it stretches both arms up in a big yawn, then its head slowly nods down forward and it dozes off standing, breathing slowly while asleep with its head drooped, then it wakes up with a little start and returns to exactly the starting pose.
dizzy: It is dizzy: it wobbles unsteadily, its big head sways around in circles, it stumbles slightly left and right on its short feet, then shakes it off and steadies itself back into exactly the starting pose.
angry: It gets grumpy: it stomps one small foot twice, puts both stubby paws on its hips and puffs up, gives a small huffy shake, then calms down back into exactly the starting pose.
shy: It gets shy: it covers its face screen with both stubby paws, twists its body bashfully side to side, peeks out by lowering its paws a little, then lowers the paws back into exactly the starting pose.
